scope: Source-checked paraphrases, not raw website text. Known development case, not practitioner or held-out acceptance. No live data modified.

sections.research.business: Complete source excerpts identify target product/customer and distinguish partner/advisory entity; reported benefits and registration remain qualified.
sections.research.economics: Access recurring-fee versus brokerage distinction and Apex annual AUM basis/monthly collection/separate brokerage/no markup all preserved. Retained revenue remains unknown.
sections.research.decision: Conditional Apex income-after-variable-cost and funding case; participation failure changes the decision without asserting observed losses or causation. Narrower than the reference, but valid initial test.
sections.founder.observation: Faithful attributed opening with relevant retained-income question.
sections.founder.proposal: Unsent outside-adviser contribution/customer offer, requests billing/ledger/supplier/customer-event inputs and names tables plus operating decision. Detailed records and funding-event definition are in linked requests.
sections.diligence.request_a: Accounting, partner treatment, entity, period and direct costs are requested; assets/principal excluded and already-net partner charges not deducted twice.
sections.diligence.request_b: Distinct funding-activation request with anonymized customer keys, eligibility and equal follow-up. No satisfaction/causal claims.
sections.readiness.action_a: Canonical retained recognized revenue minus attributable variable costs; explicit entity confirmation, same service/accounts/period and missing-input behavior.
sections.readiness.action_b: Unique funded customers over eligible registered customers, equal ninety-day exposure, immature cohorts excluded, unresolved missing data and baseline-derived experiment threshold.

minor_edits: Source excerpts and attached evidence duplicate text in Markdown; could shorten presentation without removing qualifications.
Founder proposal can name funding activation explicitly and point to the full direct-cost/staff-allocation request.
The Apex-only initial test does not replace subsequent Access analysis or advisory retention work.
limitations: The app generates proposals and requests; no company records were analyzed and no economic or customer result was verified.
Nine usable sections on one frozen case do not establish universal reliability or the architecture MVP release gates.
